lines: Can you hear our small voice?
Those stars blurring in my shining lashes
Will you satisfy our dream?
I'm praying — a wish unchanged since childhood
The future we swore to inside our graduation album
Everyone looks back on it innocently at least once
Don't give up on your wish
Don't hide the weakness soaked into your chest
Sky and earth embracing each other — beneath those clouds, we long once more
Become the wind
I wanna tell you a messege
The truth is, I felt like I'd start crying, and it hurt
But I can say right now
Piling up and falling, darkness and light lie side by side
Deep in the heart, someday there's a "goodbye"
Only after parting with something can we grow strong
Now is the time to spread your wings — without fear, fly with all your might
When you see hand overlapping hand
You'll understand that everything in this world
Can become one
Here in the pouring rain, if we gathered the dreams of the whole world
Like a mother holding her child, I'd cradle them in these hands all night long and pray
I wish...
When the morning sun rose, at the hour of beginning — the courage we were born with carries us down the distant road
Words overflowing from both hands, all I want to tell you — the pain, the weakness, the bravado, all of it
Don't give up on your wish
The past we raced through, the present, the future — surely
I'll live on loving them, through whatever comes
More precious than the sky, than the sea, than the wind, than the waves, than dreams
Become us
